value.name: g_city_health

items.en: 18/19 'There is a lot of unrest in the city' (3 lines), 21 'There is some unrest in the city', 22 'There are stirrings of unrest in the city' (4 lines), 23 'There is no unrest in the city' (3 lines)

value.name: set by city_crime_level 0x00519910
value.meaning: over all houses (state 1, is_house): H = count with unrest >80, M = count with unrest 71..80, N = all houses. No house with unrest >=51 -> 23. Else M*100/N >=51 -> 18; else H*100/N >=26 -> 19; else H*100/N <11 -> 22; else 21. (Houses with 51..70 only flip 'any' so give 22 at least.)
value.ours: needs per-house unrest (Building.crime, exported as 'unrest' by the overlay columns in sim/export.py ~l.84, not in the saved state.json buildings[]); fallback reports.hygiene[2] 'average unrest (common houses)'

6.modes: G = (0x00902C50 != -1): the scenario schedules Panhellenic games (scenario field = start-year offset). Open-play sandbox: hyp G false -> 'Culture in your city' layout.

items.en: G: 'Likely Standing in Panhellenic Games' (2 lines); else 'Culture in your city' (2 lines: 'Culture in' / ' your city')

items.y: n*20+0x41+lines*16-8 = n*20+0x59 (both titles wrap to 2 lines)

items.x: panelX+55 (+ pen-4 after the G prefix)

value.meaning: % population with philosopher coverage (+0x6D) — Building +0x6D/+0x6F/+0x71/+0x6C coverage bytes; FUN_00566A90 (cycle step 33) = population of houses with byte != 0 *100 / all house population
value.ours: pop-weighted share of houses with buildings[].coverage.philosophy>0; or reports.culture[0].table row philosophy 'houses reached'

items.font: G: rating font; else 13 for Yes, 14 for No
items.en: not G: 'Yes' iff a stadium exists (g_unique_venue_exists 0x00FEAED0 != 0) and staffed stadiums (0x007829C8 = count[0x50]) >= 1 and g_unique_venue_shows 0x00FEAED2 >= 1; else 'No'

value.meaning: stadium built, staffed, and holding shows
value.ours: any stadium with employees>0 in buildings[] (culture table row competition venues)

ratings.score: S1 = cov_phil/4 + staffed colleges(0x4D) + staffed podiums(0x51); S2 = cov_ath/4 + 5*staffed stadiums(0x50) + staffed gymnasiums(0x4F); S3 = cov_drama/4 + staffed drama schools(0x4E) + staffed theatres(0x52); S0 = (S1+S2+S3)/3 + 4*staffed stadiums; each +20 if god_sanctuary_active() (which god: hyp). Staffed counts = 0x00782888[type] (buildings_count_by_type 0x00491820, workers>0: hyp for these types)

6.poseidon_variant: 0x00519D50: title 58:75 'Science in the city' (panelX+65, w100, 2 lines); separator; rows 58:76 'Astronomy' + rating(0x0091EA74), 58:77 'Research' + rating(0x0091EA7C), 58:78 'Learning' + rating(0x0091EA78), 58:79 'Exhibits' + 18:1 'Yes' (font 13) iff unique venue exists, staffed museums 0x00782BC4 (type 0xCF) >= 1 and shows >= 1, else 18:0 'No' (font 14). 6.notes: No widgets (panel_click has no case 6). Ratings show words only, never percentages. Our sim: compute R1-R3 from buildings[] house coverage (pop-weighted by occupants) and 'Yes' if a staffed stadium exists; the G layout is not needed (no games).
